Medicube

Glow Mode: ON

Pop Up Mob brought Medicube's Booster Pro to life through Glow Mode: ON, a retro-future arcade where classic games were reimagined around each device mode to gamify skincare education and make it immersive, playful and memorable.

BeautyOctober – November 2025NYC, New York70% Experiential
The Story
NYC, New York

Pop Up Mob created Glow Mode: ON for Medicube, transforming its award-winning Booster Pro into a retro-future arcade designed to make beauty tech feel intuitive, engaging, and culturally relevant. The objective was to educate consumers on a multi-mode skincare device by turning each function into something instantly understood through play. Inside the space, every touchpoint was developed as part of a fully realized Medicube arcade universe, with custom branding by the Pop Up Mob team spanning the logo, graphic system, and retro-inspired visuals shaped by the wavelengths of each Booster Pro mode. Education was built directly into the experience through four custom arcade games, each tied to a specific device mode, while arcade-style consoles made product trial a thematic extension of the world itself. Open to press, influencers, and New Yorkers alike, and amplified by Kendall Jenner's attendance, Glow Mode: ON positioned Medicube at the intersection of K-beauty, tech, and culture.
